text:
lee: anyone else seeing a spike in OOMs after kernel-selector rollout (deploy 312)? 2 incidents on p100-prod-3 in the last hour, both during heavy kv-prefetch + batching runs. nvprof snippet pasted below.

deploy-bot: deploy 312 -> kernel-selector v2.4 rolled to prod at 2026-03-18T09:12:00Z :white_check_mark:

maria: can you paste the GPU high-water and the failing alloc size? also which workload (chat/emb/rerank)?

lee: sure — chat-heavy, long prefix reuse + prefetch enabled. GPU is 80GB (A100-ish topology but these p100s are ~80GB here). high-water: 78.3GB, attempted alloc: 5.7GB, OOM triggered. pattern looks like fragmentation: a lot of free small segments but no single contiguous block. snippet: 

```
# nvprof-like summary (cropped)
malloc: 5.7GB failed -> calling allocate_workspace
free segments: counts by size bucket: [<=16MB: 142, 16-128MB: 38, 128-1024MB: 3, >=1GB: 0]
high_watermark: 78.3GB / 80.0GB
concurrent_live_allocs (tail): 512 reqs, avg 48MB, spikes to 2.1GB/sec
```

ankur: this smells like a split/max-split sizing problem combined with kernel routing that increased long-prefix batching. quick mitigations to try (staging first):
- set RW_ALLOC_MAX_SPLIT_MB=64 (reduce big contiguous split allocations)
- set RW_ALLOC_EXPANDABLE_SEGMENTS=1 (allow segments to grow instead of forcing new big contiguous chunks)
- set RW_ALLOC_GC_THRESHOLD=0.5 (more aggressive GC before OOM)

priya: also throttle kv-prefetch concurrency or cap batch concurrency per-GPU (we saw similar with rerank traffic where prefetch floods the allocator). e.g. `kv_prefetch_window=4` and `max_concurrent_batches_per_gpu=6` for staging.

maria: +1 to running a repro harness: run the offending chat workload in staging with `--trace-allocs` and `--alloc-debug=frag` so we can get a full fragmentation timeline and a flamegraph. please include a timeline of kernel-selector decisions so we can correlate batching + kernel changes.

lee: will run these in staging now. command I'll run: 

```
./run_stress.sh --profile alloc --workload chat_longprefix --concurrency 12 \
  --env RW_ALLOC_EXPANDABLE_SEGMENTS=1 RW_ALLOC_MAX_SPLIT_MB=64 RW_ALLOC_GC_THRESHOLD=0.5 \
  --runtime-opts "--trace-allocs --alloc-debug=frag" \
  --kv-prefetch-window 4 --max-concurrent-batches-per-gpu 6
```

ankur: if the staging run stabilizes, we can push the knobs as a hotfix via a config-only rollout. if it still OOMs, we should roll back the kernel-selector to v1.9; the selector change increased large-batch-prefetch routing in canary metrics.

lee: ok i'll attach the staging logs & a small allocation flamegraph when done. aiming for a hotfix canary at ~1400 UTC if staging looks good. thanks all :pray:

maria: one more note — add a short perf test to CI that runs a 6min mixed chat/emb workload with these alloc traces so we catch regressions on future kernel selector changes.

lee: added to my runbook. I'll post results in this thread.
